summary: Example task backs up the NX-OS config with nxos_config backup: yes.
questions: How do I back up a Nexus switch config?

answer_card.title: Back up NX-OS config
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (nxos)
  cisco.nxos.nxos_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_nxos_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'cisco.nxos.nxos'
```
